tests.title: Accept an uploaded bank transfer receipt from the order detail
tests.goal: Staff can approve a bank transfer payment after the customer uploads a receipt.
preconditions: A QA member order paid by Bank Transfer with an uploaded receipt (status Payment Review)
User approval to place the order
data: Order found at runtime in Orders > Payment review, created by the QA member

steps.text: Open the order detail > Receipt tab
Enter a comment and click Accept > OK
Reload the order
Open eShop My Orders for that order

expected.text: No warning is shown
Order Status Processing, Payment Status Paid
eShop shows the order as Processing

checks.label: No warning is shown
Order Status Processing, Payment Status Paid

notes: TXN0126102700004: Receipt > Accept > OK, no warning; Processing, payment Complete. eShop My Orders not checked (member password unknown). BUG-009 retest.

tests.title: Approve a payment-review order and verify processing status
tests.goal: Approving a QA payment-review order advances it to the appropriate processing state.
preconditions: A dedicated staging QA order is in Payment review and uses a non-routable QA contact.
A safe staging payment-review action is available; do not use a live payment rail.
data: Existing QA order selected dynamically by Payment review status.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM.
Open the QA order in Payment review and confirm its order number and amount.
Approve the payment review.
Reopen the order and its status history.

expected.text: The order leaves Payment review and shows the resulting processing/approved status.
The order history records the approval and updated status.

checks.label: The order leaves Payment review and shows the resulting processing/approved status.
The order history records the approval and updated status.

notes: TXN0126102700002A: Payment review > Bulk Accept Receipt (1) > Start: Completed 1/1; Processing / payment Complete; Status History has Processing with the comment. BUG-009 retest.

tests.title: Award loyalty points once for an eligible QA purchase
tests.goal: A completed eligible QA purchase awards the configured loyalty points exactly once.
preconditions: A dedicated staging QA member has a visible points balance.
A documented sandbox checkout method and eligible product are available.
data: Eligible product and qualifying order amount selected from current loyalty rules.

steps.text: Record the QA member points balance and current earn rule.
Complete one qualifying sandbox purchase for the QA member.
Reopen the member loyalty balance and order history.
Refresh the balance and confirm the same order did not award points twice.

expected.text: The points increase by the amount defined in the current earn rule.
The completed order is linked to the point entry.
Reloading does not duplicate the points entry.

checks.label: The points increase by the amount defined in the current earn rule.
The completed order is linked to the point entry.
Reloading does not duplicate the points entry.

notes: Bank Transfer orders: +4 for HKD 49 (TXN0126102700004) and +39 for HKD 390 (2A), awarded once at payment acceptance; no extra entry at dispatch/complete or after reload.

tests.title: Fulfil a paid online pickup order: pack, dispatch and complete
tests.goal: A paid eShop order can be packed and dispatched in the CRM and ends Complete, with stock deducted once.
preconditions: A QA member eShop order paid by Bank Transfer and accepted (status Processing, payment Complete)
data: Order found at runtime in Orders > Processing, created by the QA member

steps.text: Open the order detail and click Delivery
Click Pack All, then Save
Click Dispatch and confirm OK
Reload the order and open Status History
Open Inventory History for the product

expected.text: Save shows "update successfully"
Order Status, Payment Status and Delivery Status are Complete; Delivered equals ordered qty; Completed Date set
Status History lists processing then complete
Inventory History shows one DELIVERED -1 Stock Qty entry for the order at the order warehouse

checks.label: Save shows "update successfully"
Order Status, Payment Status and Delivery Status are Complete; Delivered equals ordered qty; Completed Date set
Status History lists processing then complete
Inventory History shows one DELIVERED -1 Stock Qty entry for the order at the order warehouse

notes: TXN0126102700004 (門市自取): Pack All, Save, Dispatch -> Complete 15:09, Delivered 1; Inventory History DELIVERED -1 TaiPo. Side findings filed as BUG-018.

tests.title: Exchange a completed QA order and verify the linked exchange
tests.goal: An exchange creates a linked exchange record for a completed QA order.
preconditions: A completed staging QA order is eligible for exchange and uses only QA product/contact data.
data: QA order and eligible replacement item selected dynamically.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM.
Open the completed QA order and choose the exchange flow.
Select the eligible replacement item and confirm the exchange using the staging flow.
Open the resulting order and its history.

expected.text: The exchange record references the original QA order.
The exchange shows the selected replacement item and resulting status.

checks.label: The exchange record references the original QA order.
The exchange shows the selected replacement item and resulting status.

notes: TXN0126102700004 exchanged at Storeberry HK for 偈油x10 -> TXN1126102700004 (Complete, Exchange Order, refund 40.50 Cash); original shows Exchanged: 1 and is in the Exchanged tab; returned unit +1 at TEST12. Points -5 although the order earned +4 (BUG-017).

tests.title: Receiving a purchase order updates warehouse stock
tests.goal: Receiving a purchase order increases the selected warehouse stock by the accepted quantity.
preconditions: A staging warehouse, supplier, and product with sufficient stock capacity are available.
data: Product and quantity selected from staging data; use a small controlled quantity.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM and record the available quantity of a suitable test product at a staging warehouse.
Create a uniquely numbered purchase order for that product, an existing supplier, and a small controlled quantity.
Receive the full quantity on the purchase order.
Reopen Inventory and Inventory History for the product.

expected.text: The purchase order reaches Received status and displays a receive time.
Available quantity at the selected warehouse increases by the received quantity.
Inventory History contains the receipt linked to the PO/Lot number.

checks.label: The purchase order reaches Received status and displays a receive time.
Available quantity at the selected warehouse increases by the received quantity.
Inventory History contains the receipt linked to the PO/Lot number.

notes: Lot2610270903405b1b (TaiPo, product test 2 x2, Default Supplier): receive 1 -> Partial Received, receive 1 -> Received 17:04:39; receive qty capped at outstanding qty; Inventory History REPLENISHMENT +1/+1 linked to the lot.

tests.title: Staff creates an online store order via Add Order (WebPOS) with store pickup
tests.goal: Staff can create an online order for a member from Orders > Add Order > Add Online Store Order via WebPOS.
preconditions: An in-stock product at the online warehouse
data: Member and product found at runtime

steps.text: Orders > Add Order > Add Online Store Order via WebPOS (opens a POS tab)
Select the QA member and add one product
Shipping: choose 門市自取, enter an address, pick a pickup store, Submit
Click Total and pay by Bank Transfer

expected.text: Shipping is accepted and shown on the cart
A new online order is created in Pending payment with the chosen pickup store
Total equals subtotal minus member discount plus shipping fee

checks.label: Shipping is accepted and shown on the cart
A new online order is created in Pending payment with the chosen pickup store

notes: Shipping Submit -> "Oops... error exist!" (POST /webpos/check-shipping 500), 4/4; Total blocked. No order created.

tests.title: Order delivery panel tells staff why Dispatch or Save is refused
tests.goal: Invalid packing actions give feedback instead of silently doing nothing.
preconditions: A QA order in Processing with nothing packed

steps.text: Open the order Delivery panel and click Dispatch with nothing packed
Pack All, change the parcel qty to more than ordered (e.g. 5 of 1) and click Save

expected.text: Dispatch with nothing packed shows a message (e.g. pack items first)
Save with packed qty above ordered qty shows a message or caps the qty

checks.label: Dispatch with nothing packed shows a message (e.g. pack items first)
Save with packed qty above ordered qty shows a message or caps the qty

notes: TXN0126102700004: both actions silent, no request.
